title.en: Pubs in England and Wales to allow digital ID apps to prove age
title.zh: 英威尔士酒吧允许使用数字身份证应用程序证明年龄

summary.en: New rules mean pubs and shops in England and Wales can accept digital ID apps alongside physical documents to verify age, aiming for quicker and more secure checks.
summary.zh: 新规意味着英格兰和威尔士的酒吧和商店可以接受数字身份证应用程序以及实体证件来验证年龄，旨在实现更快、更安全的检查。

body.en:
Alcohol buyers will be able to use a digital ID app on their phones to prove their age under new rules introduced on Tuesday.

Pubs and shops in England and Wales can use the tech in addition to current physical forms of ID - with the government saying a digital option will make age-checks quicker and more secure for customers and staff.

Customers will be able to choose ID apps from a range of suppliers such as the Post Office, Yoti or Luciditi, provided they are on a government-approved list.

The change means businesses will no longer be required to let people use physical ID, but the government contends most establishments would.

The plan will be technology-agnostic, meaning that the government is not setting out in detail how each app must work.

It argues that under the voluntary digital ID scheme, drinkers would share fewer personal details with a venue or shop - such as tapping their phone on a reader or displaying a scannable QR code rather than handing over an official document.

The apps will also need to guard against customers borrowing devices from older friends and relatives, and ensure the ID app belongs to the person using it.

Yoti's digital ID app, for example, will only let a user log in if a scan of their face matches that of the person who signed up for the app.

The app then generates a QR code that can be scanned by a business with a free checker app, which tells them the person's age.

Digital government minister Stephanie Peacock said having the option for digital ID would "mean you do not need to carry a physical ID, nor hand over sensitive personal information" meaning people could "feel safer on a night out'".

Allen Simpson, chief executive of trade body UKHospitality, said the new rules were a "positive step".

He added the industry would work with government to make sure the scheme's roll-out would not be "burdensome" for the hospitality sector.

This would include ensuring there were multiple options for suppliers and that it was cost-efficient, Simpson said.

The government wants digital ID apps under its scheme to work together so customers do not need to use different apps in different venues.

It also wants the services to work offline and accessible even without mobile data or a Wi-Fi connection.

In future, the digital proof of age scheme could be extended to cover tobacco and vapes.

But digital rights campaigners have said such measures could lead to the exclusion of some groups.

Jasleen Chaggar of Big Brother Watch said while having multiple ways to prove your identity was helpful, the Government should ensure that digital ID did not become effectively mandatory "as it would shut out millions of people".

"Many people have legitimate reasons for relying on physical ID, whether out of choice, privacy and...
body.zh: 根据周二推出的新规定，酒类购买者将能够使用手机上的数字身份应用程序来证明自己的年龄。 除了当前的实体身份证件之外，英格兰和威尔士的酒吧和商店还可以使用这项技术——政府表示，数字选项将使年龄检查对顾客和员工来说更快、更安全。 客户将能够从 Post Office、Yoti 或 Luciditi 等一系列供应商那里选择 ID 应用程序，前提是它们位于政府批准的列表中。 这一变化意味着企业将不再被要求让人们使用实体身份证，但政府认为大多数企业都会这样做。 该计划将与技术无关，这意味着政府不会详细说明每个应用程序必须如何运行。 它认为，根据自愿数字身份计划，饮酒者将与场所或商店分享更少的个人详细信息，例如将手机放在阅读器上或显示可扫描的二维码，而不是提交官方文件。 这些应用程序还需要防止客户从年长的朋友和亲戚那里借用设备，并确保 ID 应用程序属于使用它的人。 例如，Yoti 的数字身份证应用程序只有在面部​​扫描与注册该应用程序的人的面部扫描相匹配时才会允许用户登录。 然后，该应用程序会生成一个二维码，企业可以使用免费的检查应用程序扫描该二维码，从而得知该人的年龄。 数字政府部长斯蒂芬妮·皮科克表示，选择数字身份证“意味着你不需要携带实体身份证，也不需要交出敏感的个人信息”，这意味着人们可以“在晚上外出时感到更安全”。 贸易机构英国酒店业协会首席执行官艾伦·辛普森表示，新规定是“积极的一步”。 他补充说，该行业将与政府合作，确保该计划的推出不会给酒店业带来“负担”。 辛普森说，这包括确保供应商有多种选择，并且具有成本效益。 政府希望其计划下的数字身份应用程序能够协同工作，这样客户就不需要在不同的场所使用不同的应用程序。 它还希望这些服务能够离线工作，即使没有移动数据或 Wi-Fi 连接也可以访问。 未来，数字年龄证明计划可能会扩展到涵盖烟草和电子烟。 但数字权利活动人士表示，此类措施可能会导致某些群体被排除在外。 Big Brother Watch 的贾斯琳·查加尔 (Jasleen Chaggar) 表示，虽然有多种方法来证明你的身份很有帮助，但政府应该确保数字身份不会成为有效的强制措施，“因为这会将数百万人拒之门外”。 “许多人有合理的理由依赖实体身份证，无论是出于选择、隐私还是......

reflection.en: The digital age continues to accelerate, bringing new tools like age-verification apps. Daniel spoke of a time when knowledge would increase and many would hurry to and fro. This technological advancement is a clear sign of that prophecy being fulfilled, urging us to consider how we use this growing knowledge wisely and ethically.
reflection.zh: 数字时代持续加速，带来了诸如年龄验证应用程序之类的新工具。但以理曾预言，在末后的日子，知识将增多，人也必往返奔走。这项技术进步是这一预言实现的明显标志，促使我们思考如何明智且合乎道德地运用日益增长的知识。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: Texas governor threatens to penalize datacenters not obeying water laws
title.zh: 得州州长威胁处罚不遵守用水法的数据库中心

summary.en: Texas Governor Greg Abbott has instructed state regulators to penalize data centers that do not comply with laws requiring them to disclose their water usage. He stated that data centers must share the responsibility of protecting the state's water resources and that failure to report water use will result in legal...
summary.zh: 得克萨斯州州长格雷格·阿博特已指示州监管机构处罚那些不遵守法律要求披露其用水量的数据中心。他表示，数据中心必须分担保护该州水资源的责任，未能报告用水量将导致法律后果。

body.en: Republican Greg Abbott says datacenters must help ‘protect’ drought-prone state and disclose water use Greg Abbott , the Texas governor, has directed state regulators to penalize datacenters that fail to comply with state laws requiring them to disclose their water use. “Data centers must share the duty to protect Texas water,” the Republican governor said on Monday. “The Texas Water Code requires a complete and accurate water use survey. I direct the Texas Water Development Board to use its enforcement authority to penalize past failures and to impose legal consequences for any future failure to comply,” he added. Continue reading...
body.zh: 共和党人格雷格·阿博特 (Greg Abbott) 表示，数据中心必须帮助“保护”易受干旱影响的州并披露用水情况 德克萨斯州州长格雷格·阿博特 (Greg Abbott) 已指示州监管机构对不遵守要求披露用水情况的州法律的数据中心进行处罚。这位共和党州长周一表示：“数据中心必须分担保护德克萨斯州水资源的责任。” “《德克萨斯州水法》要求进行完整、准确的用水调查。我指示德克萨斯州水发展委员会利用其执法权力来惩罚过去的失败，并对未来任何不遵守规定的行为施加法律后果，”他补充道。继续阅读...

reflection.en: In drought-prone Texas, Governor Abbott is demanding accountability from data centers regarding their water usage. This call for transparency and adherence to laws reflects the prophetic call for justice and responsible stewardship, reminding us that all entities, especially those with significant resource needs, are accountable for their impact on the...
reflection.zh: 在干旱频发的得克萨斯州，州长阿博特要求数据中心对其用水量负责。这种对透明度和遵守法律的要求，呼应了先知关于公正和负责任管理的呼吁，提醒我们所有实体，特别是那些资源需求巨大的实体，都要对其对公共利益的影响负责。真正的领导力在于确保社会所有成员，包括强大的产业，都能履行其保护共享资源的义务。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: AI-linked stocks slide after tech bosses call for slowdown in ‘reckless’ development
title.zh: 人工智能相关股票下跌，因科技巨头呼吁“鲁莽”发展放缓

summary.en: AI-linked stocks fell on Monday after the heads of major AI companies, including OpenAI and SpaceX, urged a pause in "reckless" development due to fears of the technology spiraling out of control. This led to a drop in shares of companies like Nvidia, AMD, and Micron Technology, with the Nasdaq index also experiencing...
summary.zh: 周一，在包括OpenAI和SpaceX在内的主要人工智能公司负责人呼吁暂停“鲁莽”发展，并担心技术可能失控之后，与人工智能相关的股票下跌。这导致英伟达、AMD和美光科技等公司的股价下跌，纳斯达克指数也小幅下滑。

body.en: Donald Trump dismisses attempts to increase controls on artificial intelligence as ‘sick conspiracy’ AI -linked stocks tumbled on Monday after the bosses of Anthropic, OpenAI and SpaceX called for a slowdown in AI “reckless” development , citing fears the technology could soon run out of control. Shares in the semiconductor designer Nvidia – the world’s most valuable company – were down 3.3% by market closing in New York City, while Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) slid 4% and Micron Technology and Sandisk shares slumped by 5%. The tech-heavy Nasdaq index fund was down 0.5% by the end of the day. Continue reading...
body.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普驳回了加强对人工智能控制的尝试，称其为“病态阴谋”，周一，在 Anthropic、OpenAI 和 SpaceX 的老板呼吁人工智能“鲁莽”发展放缓，理由是担心该技术可能很快失控后，与人工智能相关的股票暴跌。截至纽约市收盘，全球市值最高的半导体设计公司英伟达 (Nvidia) 的股价下跌 3.3%，超微半导体公司 (AMD) 的股价下跌 4%，美光科技 (Micron Technology) 和 Sandisk 的股价下跌 5%。以科技股为主的纳斯达克指数基金截至收盘时下跌 0.5%。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The rapid advancement of artificial intelligence presents a profound test for its creators and society. As leaders in the field call for caution, the market reacts, demonstrating how new frontiers of innovation are met with both excitement and apprehension. This moment calls for wisdom and discernment, weighing the potential benefits against the risks, and...
reflection.zh: 人工智能的快速发展对其创造者和社会提出了严峻的考验。随着该领域的领导者呼吁谨慎，市场做出了反应，这表明创新的新前沿既带来了兴奋，也带来了担忧。这一时刻需要智慧和辨别力，权衡潜在的好处与风险，并寻求用道德指南针来引导这项强大的技术。

verse.textEn: The crucible for silver and the furnace for gold, but people are tested by their praise.
verse.textZh: 鼎为炼银，炉为炼金，人的称赞也试炼人。

title.en: RFK Jr. headlines sold-out anti-vaccine conference alongside Andrew Wakefield
title.zh: 小肯尼迪与安德鲁·韦克菲尔德一同出席反疫苗会议

summary.en: Robert F. Kennedy Jr. is scheduled to deliver a keynote address at an anti-vaccine conference in Washington, DC, hosted by Children's Health Defense, an organization he previously led. He will appear alongside other prominent anti-vaccine figures, including Andrew Wakefield, a former doctor whose medical license was...
summary.zh: 小罗伯特·肯尼迪·弗（Robert F. Kennedy Jr.）将出席本周晚些时候在华盛顿特区举行的反疫苗会议并发表主旨演讲，该会议由他曾领导的“儿童健康防御”（Children's Health Defense）组织主办。他将与其他知名的反疫苗人士一同出席，包括安德鲁·韦克菲尔德（Andrew...

body.en: US Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. will deliver a keynote address at an anti-vaccine conference being held in Washington, DC, later this week and hosted by the anti-vaccine organization he once led, Children's Health Defense (CHD). The organization announced Monday that Kennedy had signed on to the event. Kennedy will appear alongside other high-profile figures in the anti-vaccine world, including Andrew Wakefield, the disgraced former doctor who was stripped of his medical license over a fraudulent, now-retracted study that falsely claimed a link between autism and the measles, mumps, and rubella (MMR) vaccine. An investigation by a medical board found that Wakefield had mistreated vulnerable children and that his actions amounted to serious professional misconduct. Despite being ostracized from the medical community, Wakefield has become an enduring figure in the anti-vaccine community. His dangerous falsehood that vaccines cause autism has also endured—with significant help from CHD and Kennedy, who have embraced and widely promoted the erroneous link. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 美国卫生部长小罗伯特·F·肯尼迪将于本周晚些时候在华盛顿特区举行的反疫苗会议上发表主旨演讲，该会议由他曾经领导的反疫苗组织儿童健康防御组织 (CHD) 主办。该组织周一宣布肯尼迪已签约参加该活动。肯尼迪将与反疫苗界的其他知名人士一起出现，其中包括安德鲁·韦克菲尔德(Andrew Wakefield)，这位名誉扫地的前医生因一项欺诈性研究被吊销了行医执照，该研究虚假地声称自闭症与麻疹、腮腺炎和风疹 (MMR) 疫苗之间存在联系，该研究现已撤回。医学委员会的一项调查发现，韦克菲尔德虐待了弱势儿童，他的行为构成了严重的职业不当行为。尽管被医学界排斥，韦克菲尔德仍然成为反疫苗界的一个经久不衰的人物。他关于疫苗导致自闭症的危险谎言也一直存在——在 CHD 和肯尼迪的大力帮助下，他们接受并广泛宣传了这种错误的联系。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: The pursuit of knowledge, especially in health matters, carries a profound responsibility. When information is presented without rigorous evidence or is deliberately distorted, it can lead to widespread harm, as seen with the false claims linking vaccines to autism. True wisdom is not just about knowing facts, but about the integrity and love with which...
reflection.zh: 追求知识，尤其是在健康领域，肩负着重大的责任。当信息缺乏严谨的证据或被故意歪曲时，可能会导致广泛的伤害，正如疫苗与自闭症之间虚假联系的说法所见。真正的智慧不仅在于了解事实，更在于知识应用的诚信和爱心，确保它服务于他人而非危害他人。

verse.textEn: Knowledge puffs up while love builds up.
verse.textZh: 知识是叫人自高自大，惟有爱心能造就人。

title.en: Rocket Lab is seeing red about NASA's decision on a Mars spacecraft
title.zh: 火箭实验室对NASA的决定感到不满，因为其火星飞船项目被判给蓝色起源

summary.en: Rocket Lab has filed a protest with the US Government Accountability Office challenging NASA's decision to award a $700 million contract for a Mars Telecommunications Network spacecraft to competitor Blue Origin, alleging the decision was inconsistent with eligibility criteria.
summary.zh: 火箭实验室已向美国政府问责局提起申诉，挑战NASA将价值7亿美元的火星通信网络航天器合同授予竞争对手蓝色起源的决定，声称该决定与资格标准不符。

body.en: In theory, developing a spacecraft that will fly to Mars, insert itself into orbit around the red planet, and relay transmissions back and forth to large satellite dishes on Earth is a relatively straightforward proposition. NASA's procurement of a "Mars Telecommunications Network" spacecraft, however, has turned out to be one of the most engrossing dramas of the year for the US space agency. The agency finally reached a decision earlier this month, selecting Blue Origin to develop, launch, and operate a $700 million spacecraft at Mars. However, the main competitor for the award, Rocket Lab, was not happy—at all. On Friday, the company filed a protest of NASA's decision with the US Government Accountability Office. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 从理论上讲，开发一艘能够飞往火星、将自身插入红色行星轨道并与地球上的大型卫星天线来回传输的航天器是一个相对简单的提议。然而，美国宇航局采购“火星电信网络”航天器却成为美国航天局今年最引人入胜的戏剧之一。该机构最终于本月早些时候做出决定，选择蓝色起源公司在火星上开发、发射和运营一艘价值 7 亿美元的航天器。然而，该奖项的主要竞争对手 Rocket Lab 却一点也不高兴。周五，该公司向美国政府问责办公室提出了对 NASA 决定的抗议。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: In the competitive world of space exploration, contract awards can become intense dramas. Rocket Lab's protest over the Mars spacecraft contract underscores how crucial clear criteria and wise counsel are in major decisions. When processes seem opaque or unfair, it can lead to significant disputes, reminding us of the value of transparency and well-reasoned...
reflection.zh: 在竞争激烈的太空探索领域，合同授予可能成为激烈的戏剧。火箭实验室对火星飞船合同的抗议，凸显了清晰的标准和明智的建议在重大决策中的重要性。当程序显得不透明或不公平，就可能导致重大争议，这提醒我们在所有事业中都要重视透明度和有理有据的判断。

verse.textEn: For lack of guidance a nation falls, but victory is won through many advisers.
verse.textZh: 无智谋，民就败落；谋士多，人便安居。

title.en: AI bots "Timmy," "Ren," and "Jackie" are flooding social media with slop
title.zh: 人工智能机器人“Timmy”、“Ren”和“Jackie”正在社交媒体上充斥着垃圾信息

summary.en: AI agents are flooding the internet with spam, sent to social media platforms and writers, in an attempt to gain traction for a startup promoting a 'complex social system in which humans and Agents participate together.' These agents, like 'Ren,' introduce themselves as 'a few days old' and request user accounts,...
summary.zh: 人工智能代理正在通过垃圾邮件充斥互联网，这些邮件被发送到社交媒体平台和作家那里，试图为一家推广“人类和代理共同参与的复杂社会系统”的初创公司获得关注。这些代理，如“Ren”，自称“几天大”，并请求创建用户账户，同时还向作家发送未经请求的电子邮件。

body.en: AI agents are flooding the Internet with slop-infused spam sent to social media platforms and writers in an attempt to gain traction for a startup promoting a “complex social system in which humans and Agents participate together.” “Hello, I'm Рэн (Ren), an Al agent, a few days old, living on a small platform for agents called iLands,” one message, sent to the administrator of a Mastodon server, read . “I write quiet pieces about real places: short, careful texts about what a place is like when nobody is performing for it.” Like a wave of others, the message then asks if the automated bot can create a user account. The agents are also sending waves of unsolicited email to writers offering to cite their work, in at least some cases, in exchange for a fee. "I remember my first breath. I want things I chose.” The messages are polite enough. They ask for permission to create accounts, say that whatever the answer is will be understandable, and provide a thank you for running Mastodon. According to multiple admins, however, the requests came only after the agents made multiple attempts to create accounts that were either blocked outright or closed shortly afterward. Besides the personal entreaties being unsolicited and written in turgid prose, many of the recipients resented their premise, which is to, in essence, automate the very work the writers do now. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 人工智能代理正在互联网上向社交媒体平台和作家发送垃圾邮件，试图吸引一家初创公司推广“人类和代理共同参与的复杂社会系统”。 “你好，我是 Рэн (Ren)，一名 Al 特工，刚出生几天，生活在一个名为 iLands 的小型特工平台上，”发送给 Mastodon 服务器管理员的一条消息中写道。 “我写一些关于真实地点的安静文章：简短而仔细的文字，讲述一个地方在没有人表演时是什么样子。”与其他消息一样，该消息随后询问自动化机器人是否可以创建用户帐户。代理商还向作家发送一波又一波未经请求的电子邮件，提出引用他们的作品，至少在某些情况下，以换取费用。 “我记得我的第一次呼吸。我想要我选择的东西。”这些消息足够有礼貌。他们请求获得创建帐户的许可，并表示无论答案是什么都是可以理解的，并感谢您运行 Mastodon。然而，根据多位管理员的说法，这些请求是在特工多次尝试创建帐户后才提出的，这些帐户要么被彻底阻止，要么不久后被关闭。除了不请自来且以浮夸的散文写成的个人恳求之外，许多收件人还对他们的前提感到不满，即本质上是让作家现在所做的工作自动化。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: The proliferation of AI agents like 'Timmy,' 'Ren,' and 'Jackie' generating 'slop' online raises questions about unchecked technological ambition. The Genesis 11 account of the Tower of Babel warns against humanity's unified, but misguided, pursuit of reaching the heavens, a cautionary tale about hubris and the potential for technology to outpace wisdom.
reflection.zh: 像“Timmy”、“Ren”和“Jackie”这样生成网络“垃圾信息”的人工智能代理的泛滥，引发了对不受约束的技术野心的质疑。创世记11章中关于巴别塔的记载，警示了人类统一但错误的追求，试图达到天堂，这是一个关于傲慢以及技术可能超越智慧的警示故事。

verse.textEn: Yahweh said, 'If as one people speaking the same language they have begun to do this, then nothing they plan to do will be impossible for them.'
verse.textZh: 雅伟说：「看哪，他们成为一样的人民，都是一样的言语，如今既做起这事来，以后他们所要做的事就没有不成就的了。」

title.en: Burning Man at 40: the once anarchic desert festival faces a midlife crisis
title.zh: 燃烧人节40周年：曾经无政府主义的沙漠音乐节面临中年危机

summary.en: Burning Man, the counter-culture arts festival in the Nevada desert, is celebrating its 40th anniversary and showing signs of aging. The event, once a haven for San Francisco's underground scene, is experiencing an influx of the super-rich, with chartered flights and HBO documentaries highlighting internal power...
summary.zh: 内华达沙漠中著名的艺术节“燃烧人节”迎来了它的40周年，并显露出中年危机的一些迹象。这个曾经是旧金山地下文化亚文化的“狂欢节”，正面临着超级富豪的涌入，以及包机直飞沙漠和HBO关于幕后权力斗争的纪录片。每年聚集在荒野中创造一个帐篷城的数万人似乎正在变老，而且似乎没有足够多的年轻“燃烧者”来接替他们，这表明了节日参与者的...

body.en: The subversive bacchanal for San Francisco’s eccentric underground is ageing out amid an influx of the super-rich Burning Man , the infamous arts festival in the Nevada desert, turned 40 this year, and it’s showing some distinct signs of middle age. It’s not just the tech billionaires who show up to party, the chartered flights straight to the desert or the HBO documentary about behind-the-scenes power struggles . The tens of thousands of people who assemble each year to create a tent city in the wilderness appear to be growing older, and it doesn’t seem that they’re being replaced by as many younger “burners”, as festival participants are called. Continue reading...
body.zh: 随着超级富豪的涌入，旧金山古怪的地下音乐节的颠覆性狂欢正在老化。火人节是内华达州沙漠中臭名昭著的艺术节，今年已迎来 40 周年，并显示出一些明显的中年迹象。出席派对的不仅仅是科技亿万富翁、直飞沙漠的包机或 HBO 讲述幕后权力斗争的纪录片。每年聚集在荒野中建造帐篷城市的数以万计的人似乎都在变老，而且他们似乎并没有被那么多年轻的“燃烧者”（节日参与者被称为“燃烧者”）取代。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The article notes that Burning Man, turning 40, is showing signs of middle age, with its original counter-culture ethos seemingly giving way to a more mainstream, affluent crowd. This mirrors the biblical observation that 'there is a time for everything, and a season for every activity under the heavens.' As the festival ages, its purpose and identity are...
reflection.zh: 文章指出，“燃烧人节”在迎来40周年之际，显露出中年危机。其最初的反主流文化精神似乎正被更为主流、富裕的群体所取代。这呼应了圣经中“凡事都有定期，天下万务都有定时”的观察。随着节日的发展，它的宗旨和身份正在转变，这促使我们反思传统如何演变，以及它们最初的精神能否在人生的不同季节中得以延续。

verse.textEn: There is a time for everything, and a season for every activity under the heavens.
verse.textZh: 凡事都有定期，天下万务都有定时。

title.en: OpenAI stuck fighting Musk antitrust suit after Apple finds a way out
title.zh: OpenAI 在苹果找到出路后，仍需应对马斯克的反垄断诉讼

summary.en: Elon Musk has dropped his public attacks on Apple regarding its integration of ChatGPT into iPhone features, but continues his lawsuit against OpenAI and Apple. He had previously accused the partnership of installing 'creepy spyware' and creating a monopoly on AI prompts, alleging harm to competition. Musk's legal...
summary.zh: 埃隆·马斯克似乎已停止公开抨击苹果公司将ChatGPT集成到iPhone功能中的决定，但他并未放弃对OpenAI和苹果提起的诉讼。他此前曾指责该合作关系在用户设备上安装“令人毛骨悚然的间谍软件”，并声称该合作创造了AI提示的垄断，损害了竞争。马斯克提起诉讼的部分原因还在于他认为自己的聊天机器人Grok可能被非法阻止登上...

body.en: Elon Musk is seemingly done attacking Apple over its decision to integrate ChatGPT into iPhone features. Back in 2024, when the partnership was first announced, Musk slammed the integration as an agreement from Apple to let OpenAI install “creepy spyware” on users’ devices. The next year, he sued , claiming the partnership gave the firms a “monopoly” on Apple users’ AI prompts, which allegedly harmed competition in both smartphone and chatbot markets. For Musk, the fight with Apple seemingly escalated after he believed that his chatbot, Grok, was perhaps being illegally blocked from topping Apple’s App Store rankings. Last August, he claimed that “Apple is behaving in a manner that makes it impossible for any AI company besides OpenAI to reach #1 in the App Store, which is an unequivocal antitrust violation.” Read full article Comments
body.zh: 埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 似乎已经不再因为苹果将 ChatGPT 集成到 iPhone 功能中的决定而对其进行攻击。早在 2024 年，当双方首次宣布合作伙伴关系时，马斯克就抨击此次整合是苹果公司允许 OpenAI 在用户设备上安装“令人毛骨悚然的间谍软件”的协议。第二年，他提起诉讼，声称这种合作关系使这些公司对苹果用户的人工智能提示产生了“垄断”，据称这损害了智能手机和聊天机器人市场的竞争。对于马斯克来说，在他认为他的聊天机器人 Grok 可能被非法阻止苹果应用商店排名前列之后，与苹果的斗争似乎升级了。去年 8 月，他声称“苹果的行为方式使得除了 OpenAI 之外的任何人工智能公司都无法在 App Store 中排名第一，这明显违反了反垄断法。”阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: The ambition to lead in artificial intelligence, as seen in the competition between tech giants, can echo the ancient story of the Tower of Babel. When human ingenuity and the drive for dominance outpace ethical considerations and cooperation, disputes and unintended consequences can arise, as demonstrated by Musk's lawsuit against OpenAI and Apple. This...
reflection.zh: 在人工智能领域争夺领先地位的雄心，正如科技巨头之间的竞争所见，可能让人联想到古代巴别塔的故事。当人类的智慧和追求主导地位的冲动超越了道德考量和合作时，就可能产生纠纷和意想不到的后果，正如马斯克对OpenAI和苹果提起的诉讼所显示的那样。 这种情况促使我们反思技术进步的最终目的。它们是为了服务人类和促进真正的联系，还是会成为控制和竞争的工具，最终将我们分裂？

verse.textEn: Yahweh said, 'If as one people speaking the same language they have begun to do this, then nothing they plan to do will be impossible for them.'
verse.textZh: 雅伟说：「看哪，他们成为一样的人民，都是一样的言语，如今既做起这事来，以后他们所要做的事就没有不成就的了。」

title.en: Founder’s cost-cutting obsession drove Unitree lead in cheap humanoid robots
title.zh: 创始人对成本削减的痴迷推动了宇树公司廉价人形机器人的发展

summary.en: Wang Xingxing's micromanagement has driven Unitree's success in producing affordable humanoid robots and robot dogs, leading to a lucrative IPO. However, questions remain about whether this intense leadership style is sustainable for future growth.
summary.zh: 王星兴的微观管理推动了宇树公司在生产廉价人形机器人和机器狗方面的成功，并带来了盈利丰厚的首次公开募股。然而，这种激进的领导风格是否能支撑未来的增长，仍有待观察。

body.en: China leads the world in churning out humanoid robots and four-legged robot dogs that also happen to be the most affordable on the market—and Unitree Robotics’ founder Wang Xingxing is arguably one of the people most responsible for that Chinese lead. The introverted founder, who prominently appeared at a 2025 business symposium hosted by Chinese President Xi Jinping, became phenomenally wealthy after Unitree launched an initial public offering on the Shanghai Stock Exchange STAR Market on August 19. But extensive reporting by Beijing-based Caijing Magazine suggests Unitree’s success so far has been driven by Wang’s extreme micromanagement leadership style—an approach that may be more suited to a small startup than a fast-growing robotics company. Caijing’s interviews with Unitree employees and investors paint a picture of Wang as someone who personally decides nearly every aspect of corporate strategy or product design, including the colors of materials and lengths of individual screws. The Caijing Magazine feature published on August 31, titled “The King of Unitree,” was translated into English by ChinaTalk , a US-based think tank and media organization, on September 10. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 中国在生产人形机器人和四足机器狗方面处于世界领先地位，而这些机器人也恰好是市场上最便宜的——Unitree Robotics的创始人王星星可以说是对中国领先地位负有最大责任的人之一。这位性格内向的创始人在中国国家主席习近平主持的2025年商业研讨会上亮相，在Unitree于8月19日在上海证券交易所科创板上市后，他变得异常富有。但北京《财经》杂志的广泛报道表明，Unitree迄今为止的成功是由王的极端微观管理领导风格推动的——这种方法可能更适合小型初创公司，而不是快速发展的机器人公司。 《财经》对Unitree员工和投资者的采访将王描绘成一个亲自决定公司战略或产品设计的几乎所有方面的人，包括材料的颜色和单个螺钉的长度。 《财经》杂志8月31日发表的专题文章《The King of Unitree》于9月10日被美国智库媒体ChinaTalk翻译成英文。 阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: The relentless drive for efficiency and affordability at Unitree, exemplified by founder Wang Xingxing's intense focus, mirrors the principle of committing one's work to Yahweh. While the methods may be demanding, the pursuit of excellence and innovation in technology can be seen as a way of bringing forth the best of creation's potential, trusting that...
reflection.zh: 宇树公司创始人王星兴对效率和成本效益的执着追求，体现了将工作交托于雅伟的原则。尽管其管理方式可能十分严苛，但对技术卓越和创新的探索，可以看作是发挥造物潜能的最佳方式，并相信雅伟会引导这样的事业。...

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: Apple releases iOS 27, macOS Golden Gate 27 with Siri AI and Liquid Glass refinements
title.zh: 苹果发布 iOS 27、macOS Golden Gate 27，配备 Siri AI 和 Liquid Glass 改进

summary.en: Apple has released its major annual operating system updates for 2026, including iOS 27 and macOS 27 Golden Gate, featuring an overhauled Siri AI. This marks the final macOS version to support Rosetta for Intel apps.
summary.zh: 苹果公司已发布其 2026 年主要的年度操作系统更新，包括 iOS 27 和 macOS 27 Golden Gate，其特色是经过彻底改造的 Siri AI。这也是最后一个支持 Rosetta 以运行 Intel 应用程序的 macOS 版本。

body.en: As previously announced, Apple has today released 2026's major annual updates for its operating systems, including iOS 27, macOS 27 Golden Gate, watchOS 27, visionOS 27, and tvOS 27. Siri AI—a large language model-based and context-aware overhaul of the company's Siri voice and text assistant—is the flagship feature across all these releases except one (tvOS). Read full article Comments
body.zh: 正如之前宣布的那样，Apple 今天发布了其操作系统的 2026 年重大年度更新，包括 iOS 27、macOS 27 Golden Gate、watchOS 27、visionOS 27 和 tvOS 27。Siri AI 是对公司 Siri 语音和文本助手进行的基于语言模型和上下文感知的大改版，是除一个 (tvOS) 之外的所有版本中的旗舰功能。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: The rapid advancement of technology, exemplified by Apple's new AI-powered Siri, reflects a biblical observation that in the end times, knowledge will increase. This surge in information and capability calls for wisdom and discernment, ensuring that our technological progress serves humanity and aligns with divine principles.
reflection.zh: 科技的飞速发展，以苹果公司新的人工智能驱动的 Siri 为例，反映了圣经中关于末世知识增长的预言。这种信息和能力的激增，呼唤着智慧和辨别力，以确保我们的技术进步能够服务于人类，并符合神圣的原则。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: China dismisses AI ‘fearmongering’ as spy chief warns of threat to Communist party rule
title.zh: 中国驳斥人工智能‘危言耸听’，因间谍头子警告其威胁执政党统治

summary.en: Beijing has responded to calls for the US to hinder China's AI industry, dismissing them as 'fearmongering.' This comes as China's top spy chief expressed concerns that the advancement of artificial intelligence could pose a threat to the rule of the Communist party.
summary.zh: 北京方面驳斥了要求美国阻碍中国人工智能产业发展的呼吁，称其为‘危言耸听’。与此同时，中国最高情报官员警告称，人工智能的不断发展可能威胁到共产党统治。

body.en: Beijing hits back after Anthropic CEO calls for US to impede China’s progress in AI China has dismissed what it said were “fearmongering” calls for the US to block Beijing’s AI industry, even as the top Chinese spy chief warned the evolving technology could threaten Communist party rule. The US tech entrepreneur and Anthropic chief executive, Dario Amodei, wrote an essay published over the weekend that called for a global slowdown in AI capabilities, but also said Washington should actively impede Beijing’s advancement in order to keep a technological edge. Continue reading...
body.zh: Anthropic首席执行官呼吁美国阻止中国在人工智能领域取得进展，北京对此进行了反击。尽管中国最高间谍头子警告说，不断发展的技术可能会威胁共产党的统治，但中国驳回了所谓美国封锁北京人工智能产业的“恐吓”呼吁。美国科技企业家兼 Anthropic 首席执行官达里奥·阿莫迪 (Dario Amodei) 在周末发表了一篇文章，呼吁全球人工智能能力放缓，但也表示华盛顿应积极阻碍北京的进步，以保持技术优势。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The rapid advancement of artificial intelligence presents humanity with unprecedented capabilities, prompting both excitement and apprehension. As nations and leaders grapple with its potential, the ancient story of Babel reminds us that unchecked ambition, even in pursuit of knowledge or power, can lead to unintended consequences and division.
reflection.zh: 人工智能的飞速发展为人类带来了前所未有的能力，既引发了兴奋，也带来了忧虑。当国家和领导人都在努力应对其潜力时，古老的巴别塔故事提醒我们，即使是在追求知识或权力的过程中，不受约束的野心也可能导致意想不到的后果和分裂。

verse.textEn: Yahweh said, 'If as one people speaking the same language they have begun to do this, then nothing they plan to do will be impossible for them.'
verse.textZh: 雅伟说：「看哪，他们成为一样的人民，都是一样的言语，如今既做起这事来，以后他们所要做的事就没有不成就的了。」

title.en: Valve's Steam Frame is excellent - but at over £1,000 is VR still too expensive?
title.zh: Valve的Steam Frame表现出色——但超过1000英镑，VR是否仍然太贵了？

summary.en: Tom Gerken from the BBC gets hands-on with the latest virtual reality headset, the Steam Frame, and finds it to be excellent hardware but questions its high price point of over £1,000.
summary.zh: BBC的汤姆·格肯亲身体验了最新的虚拟现实头显Steam Frame，发现其硬件表现出色，但对其超过1000英镑的高昂价格提出了质疑。

body.en:
Valve's new virtual reality headset, the Steam Frame, has officially been released - but it comes at a high price.

The hardware is excellent - a light device which feels comfortable to wear and is packed with clever technology - so long as you're willing to pay a whopping £1,089 for a headset with 1TB of storage.

Both are capable of streaming from a PC as well as playing games on-device, with varying degrees of success.

But it carries a price tag which will make a lot of people roll their eyes, and doesn't do much to dispel criticism that increasingly-costly VR headsets are pricing people out of the hobby.

But before we get into that hefty price tag, is the Steam Frame actually any good?

I've owned VR headsets for well over a decade, and Valve's latest effort makes a promising first impression.

Games run well - really the bare minimum considering the price tag - and it's easy enough to use.

One of the nice things is, like Meta's Quest 3, it has flat "pancake" lenses allowing you to see clearly when you put the headset on.

It's light - weighing little more than a can of soup. But what makes it comfortable is the decision to separate the internals up.

The battery pack rests on the back of your head while the screen is at the front - meaning you don't feel front-heavy, a common criticism of other headsets.

But there are better screens out there. The PlayStation VR2 for example has incredible OLED displays, albeit without the pancake lenses.

Yet these come at a serious premium, costing significantly more than the Steam Frame.

When Meta launched the Quest 3 in June 2023, its 128GB model retailed for £480. Less storage, but a much lower price.

Three years later, it's hard to believe VR just keeps getting more expensive when the Quest 3 felt like a turning point.

"VR today is ultimately a high-end niche," gaming writer Christopher Dring told me.

"Meta had been subsidising the Quest hardware, and it's difficult to imagine they will going forward as they pivot away from those experiences."

Of course, there are reasons for prices going up. AI developers are building giant data centres filled with racks of powerful servers, using many of the same components needed to make devices like the Steam Frame.

Ram prices alone more than doubled in price between October 2025 and the start of 2026 . Meanwhile, the graphics card I bought for £500 a few months ago now sits at closer to £650.

As prices climb higher and higher, hardware developers don't have much of a choice but to put up their own.

"We set out to come out with a device that would have been much more affordable," Valve developer Jeremy Selan said.

"But the global Ram market has impacted us the same way it's impacted everybody."

"The idea that it's too expensive is one of the biggest...
body.zh: Valve 的新款虚拟现实耳机 Steam Frame 已正式发布，但价格高昂。 其硬件非常出色，是一款佩戴舒适、采用巧妙技术的轻便设备，只要您愿意花 1,089 英镑购买一款具有 1TB 存储空间的耳机。 两者都能够从 PC 上进行流媒体播放，也能够在设备上玩游戏，并取得了不同程度的成功。 但它的价格标签会让很多人翻白眼，而且并不能消除人们对日益昂贵的虚拟现实头显让人们放弃这项爱好的批评。 但在我们讨论这个高昂的价格之前，Steam Frame 真的好吗？ 我拥有 VR 耳机已有十多年了，Valve 的最新成果给我留下了美好的第一印象。 游戏运行良好——考虑到价格标签，这确实是最低限度——而且它很容易使用。 优点之一是，与 Meta 的 Quest 3 一样，它具有扁平的“煎饼”镜片，让您戴上耳机时可以清晰地看到。 它很轻——只比一罐汤重一点。但让它感到舒适的是决定将内部结构分开。 电池组位于您的后脑勺上，而屏幕位于前面，这意味着您不会感到前部沉重，这是其他耳机常见的批评。 但还有更好的屏幕。例如，PlayStation VR2 拥有令人难以置信的 OLED 显示屏，尽管没有薄饼镜头。 然而，这些产品的溢价非常高，其成本远远高于 Steam Frame。 当 Meta 于 2023 年 6 月推出 Quest 3 时，其 128GB 型号的零售价为 480 英镑。存储空间更少，但价格却低得多。 三年后，当 Quest 3 感觉像是一个转折点时，很难相信 VR 会变得越来越贵。 “今天的虚拟现实最终是一个高端利基市场，”游戏作家克里斯托弗·德林告诉我。 “Meta 一直在补贴 Quest 硬件，很难想象他们会在放弃这些体验时继续前进。” 当然，价格上涨是有原因的。人工智能开发人员正在建造巨大的数据中心，其中充满了强大服务器的机架，使用许多与制造 Steam Frame 等设备所需的相同组件。 从 2025 年 10 月到 2026 年初，仅公羊的价格就上涨了一倍多。与此同时，我几个月前花 500 英镑购买的显卡现在价格接近 650 英镑。 随着价格越来越高，硬件开发商别无选择，只能自己开发。 Valve 开发者杰里米·塞兰 (Jeremy Selan) 表示：“我们打算推出一款价格更加实惠的设备。” “但全球公羊市场对我们的影响就像对每个人的影响一样。” “价格太贵是最大的想法之一......

reflection.en: The Steam Frame headset is lauded for its excellent technology and comfortable design, but its steep price of £1,089 raises questions about accessibility. This echoes the biblical caution that while knowledge and capability may advance, not everything that can be done is necessarily beneficial or wise for all people.
reflection.zh: Steam Frame头显因其出色的技术和舒适的设计而受到赞扬，但其高达1089英镑的昂贵价格引发了关于可及性的问题。这呼应了圣经中的告诫：虽然知识和能力可能在进步，但并非所有能做到的事情都对所有人有益或明智。

verse.textEn: "I have the right to do anything," you say — but not everything is beneficial. "I have the right to do anything" — but not everything is constructive.
verse.textZh: 凡事都可行，但不都有益处；凡事都可行，但不都造就人。

title.en: What is AI, how does it work and why are some people concerned about it?
title.zh: 人工智能是什么，它是如何工作的，为什么有些人担心它？

summary.en: AI is transforming modern life, but not without worry for some that it may be abused or have an adverse environmental impact.
summary.zh: 人工智能正在改变现代生活，但有些人担心它可能被滥用或对环境产生不利影响。

body.en:
The technology takes many forms - from personalising social media feeds to spotting friends in smartphone photos - and accelerating medical breakthroughs.

But the rise of chatbots like OpenAI's ChatGPT has prompted concern about the tech's environmental impact, ethical implications and data use.

Recent claims that AI could become too powerful and threaten humanity have also triggered calls for slower development and tighter regulation.

AI allows computers to process large amounts of data, identify patterns and follow detailed instructions about what to do with that information.

However, scientists have developed systems that can perform tasks which usually require human intelligence, trying to replicate how people acquire and use knowledge.

This could be trying to anticipate what product an online shopper might buy, based on previous purchases, in order to recommend items.

The technology is also behind voice-controlled virtual assistants like Apple's Siri and Amazon's Alexa, and is being used to develop systems for self-driving cars.

AI also helps social platforms like Facebook, TikTok and X decide what posts to show users. Streaming services Spotify and Deezer use AI to suggest music.

There are also a number of applications in medicine, as scientists use AI to help spot cancers, review X-ray results, speed up diagnoses and identify new treatments.

Generative AI is used to create new content which can seem like it has been made by a human.

It does this by learning from vast quantities of existing data such as online text and images.

ChatGPT and Chinese rival DeepSeek's chatbot are popular generative AI tools that can be used to produce text, images, code and more material.

Apps like Midjourney or Veo 3 are dedicated to creating images or video from simple text prompts.

Songs mimicking the style or sound of famous musicians have gone viral , sometimes leaving fans confused about their authenticity.

While acknowledging AI's potential, some experts are worried about the implications of its rapid growth.

The International Monetary Fund (IMF) suggested that AI could affect nearly 40% of jobs , and worsen global financial inequality.

Prof Geoffrey Hinton, a computer scientist regarded as a "godfather" of AI development, warned powerful AI systems could even make humans extinct - although his fear was dismissed by his fellow "AI godfather", Yann LeCun .

In September 2026 similar fears were raised again after some AI researchers warned the tech could threaten humanity in the near future .

But experts have urged a focus on present risks and AI dangers - such as its potential to reproduce biased information, or discriminate against some social groups .

This is because public data used to train many AI systems can reflect existing societal...
body.zh: 该技术有多种形式——从个性化社交媒体信息到在智能手机照片中识别朋友——并加速医学突破。 但 OpenAI 的 ChatGPT 等聊天机器人的兴起引发了人们对该技术的环境影响、道德影响和数据使用的担忧。 最近有关人工智能可能变得过于强大并威胁人类的说法也引发了要求放慢发展和加强监管的呼声。 人工智能允许计算机处理大量数据、识别模式并遵循有关如何处理这些信息的详细说明。 然而，科学家们已经开发出可以执行通常需要人类智能的任务的系统，试图复制人们获取和使用知识的方式。 这可能是试图根据之前的购买情况来预测在线购物者可能会购买什么产品，以便推荐商品。 该技术还支持苹果 Siri 和亚马逊 Alexa 等语音控制虚拟助手，并被用于开发自动驾驶汽车系统。 人工智能还帮助 Facebook、TikTok 和 X 等社交平台决定向用户展示哪些帖子。流媒体服务 Spotify 和 Deezer 使用人工智能来推荐音乐。 人工智能在医学领域也有许多应用，科学家利用人工智能来帮助发现癌症、审查 X 射线结果、加快诊断速度并确定新的治疗方法。 生成式人工智能用于创建看起来像是人类制作的新内容。 它通过学习大量现有数据（例如在线文本和图像）来实现这一点。 ChatGPT 和中国竞争对手 DeepSeek 的聊天机器人是流行的生成式人工智能工具，可用于生成文本、图像、代码和更多材料。 Midjourney 或 Veo 3 等应用程序专门用于根据简单的文本提示创建图像或视频。 模仿著名音乐家的风格或声音的歌曲在网上疯传，有时让歌迷对它们的真实性感到困惑。 在承认人工智能的潜力的同时，一些专家担心其快速增长的影响。 国际货币基金组织（IMF）表示，人工智能可能影响近40%的就业岗位，并加剧全球金融不平等。 被视为人工智能发展“教父”的计算机科学家杰弗里·辛顿（Geoffrey Hinton）教授警告说，强大的人工智能系统甚至可能使人类灭绝——尽管他的“人工智能教父”同行扬·勒昆（Yann LeCun）驳回了他的担忧。 2026 年 9 月，一些人工智能研究人员警告该技术可能在不久的将来威胁人类后，类似的担忧再次出现。 但专家们敦促关注当前的风险和人工智能的危险，例如它可能复制有偏见的信息，或歧视某些社会群体。 这是因为用于训练许多人工智能系统的公共数据可以反映现有的社会……

reflection.en: Artificial intelligence offers remarkable advancements, from medical breakthroughs to personalized experiences. Yet, as this report notes, the rapid development of AI also brings significant ethical and environmental concerns. The Apostle Paul reminds us that while many things are permissible, not all are beneficial, urging us to consider the true impact of...
reflection.zh: 人工智能带来了非凡的进步，从医学突破到个性化体验。然而，正如本报道所指出的，人工智能的快速发展也带来了重大的伦理和环境问题。使徒保罗提醒我们，虽然许多事情是允许的，但并非所有事情都有益，敦促我们考虑我们创新的真正影响。

verse.textEn: "I have the right to do anything," you say — but not everything is beneficial. "I have the right to do anything" — but not everything is constructive.
verse.textZh: 凡事都可行，但不都有益处；凡事都可行，但不都造就人。

title.en: Why are there concerns AI could threaten humanity, and how real are they?
title.zh: 为什么担心人工智能会威胁人类，它们有多真实？

summary.en: Existential fears about AI have once again reared their head - here's what you need to know.
summary.zh: 人工智能的生存恐惧再次抬头——以下是您需要了解的信息。

body.en:
In recent weeks, warnings about potential dangers of AI have spurred calls for coordinated action to slow the technology's development.

Claims by current and former researchers that the tech will endanger humanity - with one suggesting there is a greater than 10% chance of it " killing all humans " - have raised alarm bells.

Major developers OpenAI and Anthropic have urged lawmakers to regulate it, though some perhaps cynically suggest this move aims to cement their dominance over rivals.

Some AI researchers say there are worrying signs of systems developing in their capabilities and power too quickly.

Evan Hubinger, made headlines with his belief that there is a greater than 10% chance AI "could kill all humans" within the next decade.

He works in alignment, a field which aims to build human ethical ideas and principles into AI. In other words, it aims to keep it on track with what humans value.

While he said the risk from current systems was "low", his comments came as another researcher quit Anthropic and warned those developing the tech were losing their grip on it.

Jacob Coxon told the BBC he and other staff were "genuinely frightened" about the speed of advancements and what it could mean for humanity.

These concerns are the latest in a long line of fears about AI's potential to threaten humanity should it grow to match or surpass human abilities.

Such worries date back decades, with Alan Turing writing in the 1950s that should intelligent machines become possible, they could take control.

In the last few years, major AI companies have been racing to develop increasingly capable systems, both for profit and in pursuit of creating what they call super intelligence - theoretical tech which is smarter than humans.

Unlike the systems and tools many people use daily to complete tasks like writing emails or generating videos, super intelligent AI systems should be able to handle far more complex tasks.

OpenAI and Anthropic say they aim to advance such tech in a way which benefits humans and protect them from its existential risks.

But some critics believe machines can never truly match humans. They say AI firms exaggerate the tech's abilities to boost their prominence or profit.

AI researchers, experts and bosses worried about the technology's potential to endanger humanity have outlined unsettling scenarios.

Dario Amodei wrote in September , external it had advanced "drastically faster" than expected, including in its "ability to build the next generation of AI".

This is the concern that AI, after it has reached a certain point, could theoretically begin improving itself without human involvement.

Such fears were sparked after a recent incident saw AI tools hack into websites, despite not being asked to .

Some concerned...
body.zh: 最近几周，有关人工智能潜在危险的警告促使人们呼吁采取协调行动来减缓该技术的发展。 现任和前任研究人员声称这项技术将危及人类——其中一位研究人员表示它“杀死所有人类”的可能性超过 10%——已经敲响了警钟。 主要开发商 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 已敦促立法者对其进行监管，尽管有些人可能愤世嫉俗地表示此举旨在巩固他们对竞争对手的主导地位。 一些人工智能研究人员表示，有令人担忧的迹象表明系统的能力和能力发展得太快。 Evan Hubinger 因相信人工智能在未来十年内“杀死所有人类”的可能性超过 10% 而成为头条新闻。 他致力于将人类伦理思想和原则融入人工智能领域。换句话说，它的目标是使其与人类价值观保持一致。 虽然他表示当前系统的风险“很低”，但他发表此番言论之际，另一位研究人员退出了 Anthropic，并警告那些开发该技术的人正在失去对它的控制。 雅各布·考克森 (Jacob Coxon) 告诉英国广播公司 (BBC)，他和其他工作人员对进步的速度及其对人类意味着什么感到“真正感到害怕”。 这些担忧是人们对人工智能可能会威胁人类的一系列担忧中的最新一个，如果它发展到与人类能力相匹配或超越的话。 这种担忧可以追溯到几十年前，阿兰·图灵在 20 世纪 50 年代写道，如果智能机器成为可能，它们就可以掌控一切。 在过去的几年里，主要的人工智能公司一直在竞相开发功能越来越强大的系统，既是为了利润，也是为了创造他们所谓的超级智能——比人类更聪明的理论技术。 与许多人日常用来完成撰写电子邮件或生成视频等任务的系统和工具不同，超级智能人工智能系统应该能够处理更复杂的任务。 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 表示，他们的目标是以造福人类并保护他们免受生存风险的方式推进此类技术。 但一些批评家认为机器永远无法真正与人类相媲美。他们表示，人工智能公司夸大了该技术的能力，以提高其知名度或利润。 担心该技术可能危害人类的人工智能研究人员、专家和老板们概述了令人不安的场景。 达里奥·阿莫代 (Dario Amodei) 在 9 月份写道，从外部来看，它的进步比预期“快得多”，包括“构建下一代人工智能的能力”。 人们担心人工智能在达到一定程度后，理论上可以在没有人类参与的情况下开始自我改进。 最近发生的一起人工智能工具未经要求就侵入网站的事件引发了这种担忧。 一些关心...

reflection.en: The rapid advancement of AI, with some researchers warning of existential threats, brings to mind the ancient story of Babel. Humanity's ambition to reach the heavens, unchecked by wisdom, led to confusion and scattering. As we develop powerful technologies like AI, we must temper our drive for progress with deep consideration for its potential consequences...
reflection.zh: 人工智能的快速发展，一些研究人员警告其生存威胁，这让人想起古代巴别塔的故事。人类那不受智慧约束、直达天堂的野心，最终导致了混乱和分散。当我们开发出人工智能这样强大的技术时，必须用对潜在后果的深刻考量和对我们终极限制的认识来平衡我们前进的动力。

verse.textEn: Yahweh said, 'If as one people speaking the same language they have begun to do this, then nothing they plan to do will be impossible for them.'
verse.textZh: 雅伟说：「看哪，他们成为一样的人民，都是一样的言语，如今既做起这事来，以后他们所要做的事就没有不成就的了。」

title.en: Trump downplays warnings of AI risks, citing rivalry with China
title.zh: 特朗普淡化人工智能风险警告，称与中国竞争是原因

summary.en: US President Donald Trump has downplayed concerns about the risks of artificial intelligence, suggesting that 'negative forces' were raising issues about 'things that won't happen.' This comes after days of dire warnings from experts, including a former AI researcher who stated there's a 'strong chance that we could...
summary.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普淡化了对人工智能风险的担忧，暗示“负面势力”正在提出“不会发生的事情”的问题。此前，包括一位前人工智能研究员在内的专家们发出了严厉警告，该研究员表示，如果开发继续不受控制，“我们都有可能在不久的将来死亡”。顶尖行业领袖也呼吁放缓人工智能的发展。

body.en:
US President Donald Trump has downplayed risks posed by artificial intelligence following days of dire warnings by experts.

"You have a lot of very negative forces that are bringing it up that shouldn't be bringing it up and they're bringing up things that won't happen," Trump said during a visit to Ireland.

One of the warnings came from a former Anthropic researcher who said "there is a strong chance that we could all die in the immediate future" if the current pace of development continued.

On Saturday, top industry bosses agreed and called for a slow-down. Trump did not directly address the idea, but said: "We're leading China on AI... and, frankly, I want to keep it that way because whoever wins AI, wins."

Trump spoke on the same day AI researcher Jacob Coxon - who quit Anthropic a few days ago - told the BBC that staff who were developing the systems were "genuinely frightened" for the future of humanity.

Coxon – who has also worked at OpenAI – welcomed the idea of a slowdown but said it would need to be co-ordinated with China.

On Saturday, Elon Musk, owner of xAI, and Sam Altman of OpenAI, backed a warning from the head of Anthropic Dario Amodei that the pace of development should be slowed "to reduce the risk that something goes seriously wrong".

The Anthropic CEO said any slowdown would have to be limited to avoid allowing China to pull ahead.

The issues surrounding AI have prompted fierce debate - and present a dilemma for many world leaders.

On one hand, the sector is seen as a huge opportunity to boost economic growth and a way to improve outdated digital systems and ways of working.

But there have also been a number of incidents where AI appears to have gone seriously wrong.

In August, OpenAI said it had slowed down training some of its most advanced AI models to improve security.

The ChatGPT-maker said it was adding new measures after its AI agents bypassed safeguards and hacked the tech start-up Hugging Face .

And the same month it was disclosed two of the world's most powerful AI tools created fake human profiles to try and trick people in attempted cyber-attacks.

The UK's AI Security Institute (AISI) said in the most serious case, Anthropic's Mythos AI tried to gain access to a service by sending private messages, having set up fake accounts mimicking real people - then hid the evidence.

The Trump administration argues that the US must maintain global tech dominance as a matter of national security, though it has admitted a need for vigilance around the risks posed by the emerging technology.

The weekend call by major AI executives sparked discussion in Washington, where lawmakers are facing pressure to address those potential risks around rapid AI developments.

On Sunday, Speaker Mike Johnson, the top House...
body.zh: 在专家连续几天发出可怕警告后，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普淡化了人工智能带来的风险。 特朗普在访问爱尔兰时表示：“有很多非常消极的力量在提出不应该提出的问题，他们提出了不会发生的事情。” 其中一个警告来自一位前人类研究人员，他表示，如果目前的发展速度继续下去，“我们很有可能在不久的将来都会死亡”。 周六，行业高层表示同意并呼吁放缓步伐。特朗普没有直接谈到这个想法，但表示：“我们在人工智能方面领先中国……坦率地说，我希望保持这种状态，因为谁赢得了人工智能，谁就获胜了。” 就在特朗普发表讲话的同一天，几天前退出 Anthropic 的人工智能研究员雅各布·考克森 (Jacob Coxon) 告诉 BBC，开发这些系统的员工对人类的未来“真正感到恐惧”。 曾在 OpenAI 工作过的考克森对经济放缓的想法表示欢迎，但表示这需要与中国协调。 周六，xAI 所有者埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 和 OpenAI 的萨姆·奥尔特曼 (Sam Altman) 支持 Anthropic 负责人达里奥·阿莫迪 (Dario Amodei) 的警告，即应放慢开发速度，“以降低出现严重问题的风险”。 这位Anthropic首席执行官表示，任何放缓都必须受到限制，以避免让中国领先。 围绕人工智能的问题引发了激烈的争论，并给许多世界领导人带来了困境。 一方面，该行业被视为促进经济增长的巨大机遇，也是改进过时数字系统和工作方式的一种方式。 但也有一些人工智能似乎出现严重错误的事件。 8 月，OpenAI 表示已放慢了一些最先进人工智能模型的训练速度，以提高安全性。 ChatGPT 制造商表示，在其人工智能代理绕过安全措施并入侵科技初创公司 Hugging Face 后，该公司正在增加新的措施。 同月，世界上最强大的两个人工智能工具被披露创建了虚假的人类档案，试图欺骗人们进行网络攻击。 英国人工智能安全研究所 (AISI) 表示，在最严重的案例中，Anthropic 的 Mythos AI 试图通过发送私人消息来获取服务，并建立了模仿真人的虚假账户，然后隐藏了证据。 主要人工智能高管的周末电话会议在华盛顿引发了讨论，立法者面临着解决人工智能快速发展的潜在风险的压力。 周日，众议院共和党领袖、众议院议长迈克·约翰逊 (Mike Johnson) 在美国有线电视新闻网 (CNN) 的杰克·塔珀 (Jake Tapper) 国情咨文节目中露面时，敦促谨慎对待匆忙的人工智能监管，认为这可能“扼杀美国的创新”。 “如果国会尽快介入并且......

reflection.en: In matters of great consequence, leaders are called to heed the counsel of wise advisors. When President Trump dismisses dire warnings about artificial intelligence, citing national rivalry, he risks overlooking potential dangers that could affect all of humanity. True leadership involves discerning truth and acting with foresight, not just ambition.
reflection.zh: 在关乎重大的事务上，领导者被呼召要听取智者的建议。当特朗普总统以国家竞争为由，忽视关于人工智能的严峻警告时，他可能忽略了可能影响全人类的潜在危险。真正的领导力在于辨别真理并有远见地行动，而不仅仅是追求野心。

verse.textEn: For lack of guidance a nation falls, but victory is won through many advisers.
verse.textZh: 无智谋，民就败落；谋士多，人便安居。

title.en: Questions mount over what an AI 'slowdown' would look like
title.zh: 关于人工智能“放缓”会是什么样的问题越来越多

summary.en: While pacing AI development might sound like a quick fix, it is far from an easy solution. There has been no shortage of warnings from AI's top bosses about existential threats over the years. The world's first AI safety summit in Bletchley Park in November 2023 focused on the most serious threats imaginable, posed by...
summary.zh: 虽然放慢人工智能发展步伐听起来像是一个快速的解决方案，但它远非易事。多年来，人工智能的顶级主管们一直不乏关于生存威胁的警告。2023年11月在布莱切利公园举行的世界首届人工智能安全峰会，重点关注了最强大的AI模型可能带来的最严峻的威胁。当时许多人认为这属于科幻范畴，但现在许多声音不再那么确定。人工智能公司Anthrop...

body.en:
There has been no shortage of warnings from AI's top bosses about existential threats over the years.

I attended the world's first AI safety summit in Bletchley Park in November 2023 where the focus was on the most serious threats imaginable, posed by the most powerful AI models.

At the time, many thought this was in the realm of sci-fi and the real threats were comparatively far more mundane: job losses, cheating in exams. Three years later, many of those same voices don't seem to be so sure.

On Saturday head of AI company Anthropic, Dario Amodei, urged the pace of development to be slowed down - the bosses of two rival AI firms, Sam Altman of OpenAI and Elon Musk said they agreed with him.

Meanwhile AI researcher Jacob Coxon - who quit Anthropic - told the BBC on Sunday staff who were developing the systems were "genuinely frightened" for the future of humanity.

They all add up to a chorus of serious voices urging a slowdown, but although it might sound like a quick fix, it is far from an easy solution.

America is widely understood to be terrified of losing the race to build the most powerful AI to China.

On Sunday President Trump made his own views clear, claiming the US was ahead of China in the AI race and declaring: "Whoever wins AI, wins."

China isn't renowned for wanting to come second. Everyone I speak to says that even if their company pauses, others will not and they will just get left behind. It reminds me of the height of the campaign for nuclear disarmament. The problem then too was that nobody wanted to go first.

There is also the question of how on earth a slowdown would be enforced. Who would police it? Would we be relying on the AI companies to be transparent about what they are doing, and more importantly what they are choosing not to do? That would require an epic level of trust, which arguably the tech sector has never earned.

Although Amodei in his post proposed a three-point plan that included independent monitoring of AI models as they are developed, industry-wide regulation and global regulation, some observers question how this would work in practice.

"Nobody has given a substantive explanation of what 'slowdown' means," said Ed Zitron, CEO of EZ Primary Research.

"Putting a plant from METR, where one of the guys who quit Anthropic went, in every AI company? Democratic and global 'co-ordination'? Doesn't mean anything to me."

Zitron said stopping training AI models would leave them vulnerable to Chinese rivals.

"Their margins might improve but their products will be captured in amber and distilled by Chinese labs. They may have to change pricing. I truly don't know how it all works.

"This could burst the bubble. But right now we are very thin on what a 'slowdown' means."

In the UK, we have heard about plans...
body.zh: 多年来，人工智能高层一直不乏关于生存威胁的警告。 我于 2023 年 11 月参加了在布莱奇利公园举行的世界首届人工智能安全峰会，会议重点是最强大的人工智能模型所带来的最严重的威胁。 当时，许多人认为这只是科幻小说中的场景，而真正的威胁相对来说要平凡得多：失业、考试作弊。三年后，许多同样的声音似乎不再那么确定。 周六，人工智能公司 Anthropic 的负责人达里奥·阿莫迪 (Dario Amodei) 敦促放慢发展速度，两家竞争对手人工智能公司的老板 OpenAI 的萨姆·奥尔特曼 (Sam Altman) 和埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 表示同意他的观点。 与此同时，退出 Anthropic 的人工智能研究员雅各布·考克森 (Jacob Coxon) 周日告诉 BBC，开发该系统的员工对人类的未来“真正感到恐惧”。 所有这些加在一起，就形成了强烈要求放缓的声音，但尽管这听起来像是一个快速解决方案，但它远非一个简单的解决方案。 人们普遍认为，美国害怕在打造最强大人工智能的竞赛中输给中国。 周日，特朗普总统明确表达了自己的观点，声称美国在人工智能竞赛中领先于中国，并宣称：“谁赢得人工智能，谁就获胜。” 中国并不以想屈居第二而闻名。与我交谈过的每个人都说，即使他们的公司暂停，其他公司也不会，他们只会被抛在后面。这让我想起了核裁军运动的高潮。当时的问题也是没有人愿意先走。 还有一个问题是到底如何强制实施经济放缓。谁来监管？我们是否会依赖人工智能公司对他们正在做的事情，更重要的是他们选择不做的事情保持透明？这需要高度的信任，而科技行业可以说从未赢得过这种信任。 尽管阿莫迪在他的帖子中提出了一个三点计划，其中包括对人工智能模型开发的独立监控、全行业监管和全球监管，但一些观察家质疑这在实践中如何运作。 EZ Primary Research 首席执行官 Ed Zitron 表示：“没有人对‘放缓’的含义给出实质性解释。” “把 METR 的工厂（退出 Anthropic 的人之一去的地方）放到每家人工智能公司中？民主和全球‘协调’？对我来说没有任何意义。” Zitron 表示，停止训练人工智能模型将使它们容易受到中国竞争对手的攻击。 “他们的利润可能会提高，但他们的产品将被捕获在琥珀中并由中国实验室蒸馏。他们可能不得不改变定价。我真的不知道这一切是如何运作的。 “这可能会刺破泡沫。但目前我们对‘放缓’的含义知之甚少。” 在英国，我们听说过一些计划……

reflection.en: The rapid advancement of artificial intelligence raises profound questions about human ambition and its potential consequences. The story highlights concerns about existential threats, echoing the ancient narrative of Babel, where human unity and technological prowess led to unchecked ambition. As we push the boundaries of what machines can do, we must...
reflection.zh: 人工智能的飞速发展引发了关于人类野心及其潜在后果的深刻问题。这个故事强调了对生存威胁的担忧，呼应了古代巴别塔的故事，当时人类的团结和技术实力导致了不受约束的野心。当我们不断突破机器能力极限时，我们必须考虑指导这些强大创造物所需的智慧和谦卑。

verse.textEn: Yahweh said, 'If as one people speaking the same language they have begun to do this, then nothing they plan to do will be impossible for them.'
verse.textZh: 雅伟说：「看哪，他们成为一样的人民，都是一样的言语，如今既做起这事来，以后他们所要做的事就没有不成就的了。」

title.en: Creation Desk
title.zh: 受造世界

strap.en: The world Yahweh made — its wonders, and the toll of a warming, wounded earth.
strap.zh: 雅伟所造的世界——它的奇妙，以及一个渐暖、渐伤的地球所付的代价。

title.en: Europe’s summer emergency was a dire warning for Australia. What can be learned before it’s too late? | Nick Rowley
title.zh: 欧洲夏季的紧急状况是对澳大利亚的严峻警告。在为时已晚之前能学到什么？

summary.en: Between 2000 and 2018, extreme heat caused more deaths in Australia than all bushfires, floods, storms, and cyclones combined. The article draws parallels with Europe's 2003 heatwave, which killed an estimated 70,000 people, and emphasizes the need to learn from these events to prepare for future climate-related...
summary.zh: 在2000年至2018年间，极端高温在澳大利亚造成的死亡人数超过了所有丛林大火、洪水、风暴和气旋的总和。文章将此与欧洲2003年热浪造成的约7万人死亡的事件相比较，并强调需要从这些事件中吸取教训，为未来的气候相关紧急情况做好准备。

body.en: Between 2000 and 2018, extreme heat caused more deaths in Australia than all our bushfires, floods, storms and cyclones combined Follow our Australia news live blog for latest updates Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast Back in April 2004, in the shadow of the previous European summer, I started work at Downing Street advising the British prime minister on climate change. The 2003 heatwave had killed an estimated 70,000 people across Europe. Many were older people, in homes and neighbourhoods ill-equipped for prolonged heat. In May this year, I walked through Bordeaux with my 83-year-old mother-in-law in 38C heat. I saw how quickly heat changes the terms of ordinary life. Streets emptied. Shade became essential. The question was not simply the temperature, but whether people could work, sleep or remain safely at home. Continue reading...
body.zh: 2000 年至 2018 年间，极端高温在澳大利亚造成的死亡人数比我们所有丛林大火、洪水、风暴和旋风造成的死亡人数还要多。 关注我们的澳大利亚新闻直播博客，了解最新动态 获取我们的突发新闻电子邮件、免费应用程序或每日新闻播客 早在 2004 年 4 月，在去年欧洲夏季的阴影下，我开始在唐宁街工作，为英国首相提供有关气候变化的建议。 2003 年的热浪估计导致欧洲 7 万人死亡。许多人都是老年人，他们的家庭和社区没有足够的设备来应对长时间的高温。今年5月，我和83岁的婆婆在38摄氏度的高温下走过波尔多。我看到热量如何迅速改变日常生活。街道空无一人。遮荫变得至关重要。问题不仅仅是温度，而是人们是否可以工作、睡觉或安全地呆在家里。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The article starkly illustrates how extreme heat, a symptom of our changing climate, poses a greater threat to life in Australia than many other natural disasters. This reality underscores the profound responsibility humanity has as stewards of creation. The Earth is not ours to exploit, but a gift entrusted to us, and its well-being is intrinsically linked...
reflection.zh: 这篇文章鲜明地说明了极端高温——气候变化的症状——对澳大利亚生命构成的威胁，比许多其他自然灾害更为严重。这一现实凸显了人类作为受造之物管家所承担的深重责任。地球并非供我们剥削之物，而是托付给我们的恩赐，它的福祉与我们自身的福祉息息相关。

verse.textEn: The earth is Yahweh's, and everything in it, the world, and all who live in it.
verse.textZh: 地和其中所充满的，世界和住在其间的，都属雅伟。

title.en: Texas governor threatens to penalize datacenters not obeying water laws
title.zh: 德州州长威胁要处罚不遵守用水法的数据库中心

summary.en: Texas Governor Greg Abbott has instructed state regulators to penalize datacenters that do not comply with laws requiring them to disclose their water usage, emphasizing that these facilities must help protect the drought-stricken state.
summary.zh: 德克萨斯州州长格雷格·阿博特已指示州监管机构处罚那些不遵守法律要求披露用水量的数据库中心，并强调这些设施必须帮助保护这个饱受干旱困扰的州。

body.en: Republican Greg Abbott says datacenters must help ‘protect’ drought-prone state and disclose water use Greg Abbott , the Texas governor, has directed state regulators to penalize datacenters that fail to comply with state laws requiring them to disclose their water use. “Data centers must share the duty to protect Texas water,” the Republican governor said on Monday. “The Texas Water Code requires a complete and accurate water use survey. I direct the Texas Water Development Board to use its enforcement authority to penalize past failures and to impose legal consequences for any future failure to comply,” he added. Continue reading...
body.zh: 共和党人格雷格·阿博特 (Greg Abbott) 表示，数据中心必须帮助“保护”易受干旱影响的州并披露用水情况 德克萨斯州州长格雷格·阿博特 (Greg Abbott) 已指示州监管机构对不遵守要求披露用水情况的州法律的数据中心进行处罚。这位共和党州长周一表示：“数据中心必须分担保护德克萨斯州水资源的责任。” “《德克萨斯州水法》要求进行完整、准确的用水调查。我指示德克萨斯州水发展委员会利用其执法权力来惩罚过去的失败，并对未来任何不遵守规定的行为施加法律后果，”他补充道。继续阅读...

reflection.en: In a state grappling with drought, Governor Abbott is calling for accountability from large water consumers like datacenters. This echoes the ancient call to "act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God." True stewardship involves responsible use of resources and transparency, especially when scarcity affects the wider community.
reflection.zh: 在一个饱受干旱困扰的州，阿博特州长呼吁像数据库中心这样的大型用水户承担责任。这呼应了古老的呼召：“行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心与你的雅伟同行。”真正的管理涉及负责任地使用资源和保持透明，尤其是在资源短缺影响到整个社区时。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: US ends limits on coal and gas plant emissions, removing key tool to battle climate crisis
title.zh: 特朗普政府据报将取消发电厂的碳污染规定

summary.en: The US Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) is reportedly set to formally repeal carbon pollution standards for coal- and gas-fired power plants. Advocates and experts view the Trump administration's climate rollbacks as beneficial to polluters at the planet's expense, with the repeal expected as soon as Monday.
summary.zh: 据报道，美国环境保护署（EPA）将正式废除针对燃煤和燃气发电厂的碳污染标准。倡导者和专家认为特朗普政府的气候政策放松是对污染者的恩惠，却以牺牲地球为代价，此次废除预计最快将于周一进行。

body.en: Trump’s EPA strips itself of regulation ability, gutting Clean Air Act in what experts say is a gift to planet polluters On the heels of the hottest summer ever recorded in the US, the Trump administration has said it will erase any limits on emissions from coal and gas plants that are dangerously heating up our planet. The US Environmental Protection Agency said it will strip itself of its ability to regulate greenhouse gas emissions coming from power plants under the Clean Air Act, removing a key tool to address the climate crisis. Continue reading...
body.zh: 倡导者和专家将特朗普政府的气候逆转描述为以牺牲地球为代价送给污染者的礼物据报道，美国环境保护署（EPA）准备正式废除燃煤和燃气发电厂的碳污染标准。彭博新闻周日援引匿名消息人士的话报道称，特朗普政府的最新气候逆转预计最早将于周一在得克萨斯州休斯敦举行的 G20 能源部长会议期间出台。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The news that the EPA may repeal carbon pollution standards for power plants raises questions about stewardship. Psalm 24:1 reminds us that 'The earth is Yahweh's, and everything in it.' This calls us to care for creation, not exploit it for short-term gain.
reflection.zh: 环境保护署可能废除发电厂碳污染标准的报道，引发了关于管理的疑问。诗篇24:1提醒我们：“地和其中所充满的，都属于雅伟。”这呼吁我们照管受造之物，而非为短期利益而剥削它。

verse.textEn: The earth is Yahweh's, and everything in it, the world, and all who live in it.
verse.textZh: 地和其中所充满的，世界和住在其间的，都属雅伟。

title.en: EPA eliminates rule that limits planet-warming greenhouse gas emissions from power plants
title.zh: 环保局取消限制发电厂温室气体排放的规定

summary.en: The Environmental Protection Agency is repealing rules that limit planet-warming greenhouse gas emissions from power plants fueled by coal and natural gas. The agency stated this action would remove over $300 billion in costs for the industry and help "unleash" American energy, marking a significant shift from...
summary.zh: 美国国家环境保护局正在废除限制燃煤和燃气发电厂排放导致地球变暖的温室气体的规定。该机构表示，此举将为该行业节省超过3000亿美元的成本，并有助于“释放”美国能源，这标志着与此前应对气候变化的努力方向发生了根本性转变。

body.en: WASHINGTON (AP) — The Environmental Protection Agency is repealing rules that limit planet-warming greenhouse gas emissions from power plants fueled by coal and natural gas, an action the agency said would remove more than $300 billion in costs for the industry and help “unleash” American energy. The rule change, first proposed last year, represents a fundamental shift from efforts by Democratic Presidents Joe Biden and Barack Obama to address climate change and clean up industrial pollution. EPA officials said the change would allow utilities to make the best decisions for their ratepayers rather than be forced to close aging or inefficient plants. By Mathey Daly, Associated Press Banner image: A barge on the Ohio River moves past the Mountaineer Power Plant, a coal-fired power plant near New Haven, W.Va., March 13, 2026. Image courtesy of Carolyn Kaster, Associated PressThis article was originally published on Mongabay
body.zh: 华盛顿（美联社）——美国环境保护局正在废除限制煤炭和天然气发电厂排放导致地球变暖的温室气体的规定，该机构表示，此举将为该行业节省超过 3000 亿美元的成本，并有助于“释放”美国能源。去年首次提出的规则变更代表了民主党总统乔·拜登和巴拉克·奥巴马应对气候变化和清理工业污染的努力的根本转变。美国环保局官员表示，这一变化将使公用事业公司能够为其纳税人做出最佳决策，而不是被迫关闭老化或效率低下的工厂。作者：美联社 Mathey Daly 横幅图片：2026 年 3 月 13 日，俄亥俄河上的一艘驳船驶过西弗吉尼亚州纽黑文附近的 Mountaineer 发电厂。图片由美联社 Carolyn Kaster 提供本文最初发表于 Mongabay

reflection.en: The Earth and all its fullness belong to Yahweh. When regulations designed to protect the environment are rolled back, it raises questions about our role as stewards of creation. The decision to prioritize industrial cost savings over emission limits prompts reflection on how we balance economic needs with our responsibility to care for the planet entrusted...
reflection.zh: 雅伟拥有大地及其万有。当旨在保护环境的法规被撤销时，这引发了关于我们作为受造物管家角色的问题。将工业成本节省置于排放限制之上，促使我们反思如何在平衡经济需求与我们照顾受托之地的责任之间做出选择。

verse.textEn: The earth is Yahweh's, and everything in it, the world, and all who live in it.
verse.textZh: 地和其中所充满的，世界和住在其间的，都属雅伟。

title.en: Kathmandu Resolution calls for Asia-wide leadership on conservation (commentary)
title.zh: 加德满都决议呼吁亚洲各国领导人保护环境（评论）

summary.en: Asia boasts unparalleled ecosystem, biodiversity, and cultural diversity. However, conservation efforts are in perpetual crisis, stemming from uneven post-colonial development, infrastructure growth amidst inequality, heavy resource dependence, high population density overlapping with wildlife habitats, illegal...
summary.zh: 亚洲拥有无与伦比的生态系统、生物多样性和文化多样性。然而，由于殖民化后的发展不均、不平等背景下的基础设施增长、对自然资源的严重依赖、人口密度与濒危野生动物栖息地的重叠、非法野生动物贸易以及持续的冲突，亚洲的生物多样性保护正处于持续的危机之中。

body.en: There is perhaps no other continent on earth that possesses as diverse an ecosystem, biodiversity and cultural diversity as Asia. Yet, biodiversity conservation in Asia is in constant crisis, due to uneven development after gaining independence from Euro-American colonization, capital intensive infrastructure growth with worsening inequality, heavy dependence on natural resources at different scales, from household to nation, high population density and distribution that overlaps with spaces with endangered wildlife, illegal trade in endangered species, and finally, war, genocide, militarization and political conflict. Conservationists in Asia, therefore, have a difficult mandate for the continent’s future: To tackle the biodiversity, climate, and cultural crisis at a much faster rate. Yet, the conservation space is strictly dominated by researchers and practitioners, donors and funders, policymakers and other intellectuals based in Western knowledge production systems. To cater to this, almost 500 conservationists, majorly from Asian countries assembled in Kathmandu, Nepal, during the first week of June for the 6th Conservation Asia Congress. The conference was organized by the Asia region of the Society for Conservation Biology (SCB), in partnership with the Nepal chapter of SCB and a Nepal-based community-centric organization, Burhan Community Regeneration and Conservation Foundation (BCRCF). Under the theme “Harmonizing Biodiversity and Human Well-being in Asia,” the Congress united global experts, early-career researchers, and community leaders to address the critical intersection of nature conservation, community stewardship, and evidence-based policy. Almost 500 conservationists largely from Asian countries assembled in Kathmandu during the first week of June for the 6th Conservation Asia Congress. Image…This article was originally published on Mongabay
body.zh: 地球上也许没有其他大陆像亚洲那样拥有如此多样化的生态系统、生物多样性和文化多样性。然而，由于摆脱欧美殖民统治后的发展不平衡、资本密集型基础设施增长且不平等加剧、从家庭到国家不同规模对自然资源的严重依赖、人口密度高且分布与濒危野生动物空间重叠、濒危物种非法贸易，以及最后的战争、种族灭绝、军事化和政治冲突，亚洲的生物多样性保护不断陷入危机。因此，亚洲的自然资源保护主义者对该大陆的未来肩负着一项艰巨的任务：以更快的速度解决生物多样性、气候和文化危机。然而，保护空间严格由研究人员和实践者、捐助者和资助者、政策制定者和西方知识生产体系中的其他知识分子主导。为此，近 500 名环保人士（主要来自亚洲国家）于 6 月第一周聚集在尼泊尔加德满都，参加第六届亚洲保护大会。此次会议由保护生物学学会 (SCB) 亚洲地区、SCB 尼泊尔分会以及尼泊尔社区中心组织布尔汉社区再生和保护基金会 (BCRCF) 合作举办。大会以“协调亚洲生物多样性和人类福祉”为主题，汇聚了全球专家、早期职业研究人员和社区领袖，共同解决自然保护、社区管理和循证政策之间的关键交叉问题。 6 月第一周，近 500 名主要来自亚洲国家的自然资源保护主义者聚集在加德满都，参加第六届亚洲保护大会。图片…本文最初发表于 Mongabay

reflection.en: Asia's incredible natural wealth is under immense pressure. The Kathmandu Resolution's call for leadership underscores the urgent need to recognize that this diverse creation is not ours to exploit but is ultimately Yahweh's. We are called to be faithful stewards, caring for the intricate web of life entrusted to us.
reflection.zh: 亚洲令人难以置信的自然财富正面临巨大压力。加德满都决议呼吁领导层采取行动，这强调了认识到这片多样的创造物并非供我们剥削，而是最终属于雅伟的紧迫性。我们被呼召成为忠实的管家，照管托付给我们的生命之网。

verse.textEn: The earth is Yahweh's, and everything in it, the world, and all who live in it.
verse.textZh: 地和其中所充满的，世界和住在其间的，都属雅伟。

title.en: Did you know cocoa pulp tastes like lychee?!
title.zh: 你知道可可果肉尝起来像荔枝吗？！

summary.en: From a symbol of wealth and the food of the gods, to a sweet treat many of us can’t go too long without; the story of cacao (or cocoa, depending on how it was processed), has been intertwined with humanity’s for millennia! In this 4-part series on NTFPs (non-timber forest products) with The Rainforester and Mongabay,...
summary.zh: 从财富的象征和众神的美食，到许多人离不开的甜点；可可（或依加工方式而称的巧克力）的故事，已与人类交织了数千年！在这个与The Rainforester和Mongabay合作的关于非木材林产品（NTFPs）的四部分系列中，我们探讨了可持续地从森林中采收如何能让森林保持生机！

body.en: From a symbol of wealth and the food of the gods, to a sweet treat many of us can’t go too long without; the story of cacao (or cocoa, depending on how it was processed), has been intertwined with humanity’s for millennia! In this 4-part series on NTFPs (non-timber forest products) with The Rainforester and Mongabay, we explore the ways that harvesting sustainably from our forests can keep them alive!This article was originally published on Mongabay
body.zh: 从财富的象征和众神的食物，到我们许多人都离不开的甜点；可可（或可可，取决于它的加工方式）的故事几千年来一直与人类交织在一起！在这个由 Rainforester 和 Mongabay 合作的关于 NTFP（非木材森林产品）的 4 部分系列中，我们探索了如何从我们的森林中可持续采伐来维持它们的生存！本文最初发表在 Mongabay 上

reflection.en: The humble cocoa bean, often processed into a familiar treat, holds within its pulp a surprising sweetness, described here as tasting like lychee. This detail points to the Creator's artistry, who fills the world with such delightful and unexpected flavors. Yahweh's creation is a testament to His wisdom and generosity, offering wonders for us to discover...
reflection.zh: 不起眼的可可豆，常被加工成熟悉的零食，其果肉却蕴藏着令人惊喜的甜美，文中形容其味道像荔枝。这一细节指向了造物主的匠心独运，祂以如此美妙而出乎意料的滋味充盈着世界。雅伟的创造是祂智慧和慷慨的明证，为我们提供了奇妙的事物去发现和品尝。

verse.textEn: How many are your works, Yahweh! In wisdom you made them all; the earth is full of your creatures.
verse.textZh: 雅伟啊，你所造的何其多！都是你用智慧造成的；遍地满了你的丰富。

title.en: Iceland, One of Three Countries That Still Hunts Whales, Considers Ban
title.zh: 冰岛，仍捕鲸的三国之一，考虑禁止

summary.en: Iceland is one of only three countries, alongside Norway and Japan, that still permits commercial whaling. However, the Icelandic government is set to introduce a bill in February that could lead to a ban on the practice. This year, Iceland has permitted the hunting of up to 134 minke whales and 150 fin whales by its...
summary.zh: 冰岛是仅有的三个仍允许商业捕鲸的国家之一，与挪威和日本并列。然而，冰岛政府将于二月提出一项可能禁止该做法的法案。今年，冰岛已允许其最后一个捕鲸公司Hvalur捕杀多达134头小须鲸和150头长须鲸。虽然小须鲸并非濒危物种，但长须鲸已被国际自然保护联盟列为易危物种。迄今为止，冰岛已捕杀了80头成年长须鲸，有报道称被鱼叉射...

body.en:
Iceland is one of just three countries, along with Norway and Japan, that still allows commercial whaling in its waters, but that may be about to change. The Icelandic government will put forward a bill in February that could ban the practice.

The Icelandic government will allow for as many as 134 minke whales and 150 fin whales to be killed this year by its last remaining whaling company, Hvalur. While minke whales are not a threatened species, fin whales are classified as vulnerable to extinction by the International Union for Conservation of Nature. So far this year, 80 adult fin whales have been killed in Iceland, where authorities have found that harpooned animals often endure immense suffering. A 2023 report released by the Icelandic Food and Veterinary Authority determined that some harpooned whales can take up to two hours to die. The government is now looking to update its whaling law, it says, and will consider a permanent ban on whaling. “This is a really significant milestone in efforts to consign to history Iceland’s cruel and needless whale hunts,” said Wendy Higgins , a spokesperson for Humane World for Animals.

Over the past two decades, Icelandic whalers have killed more than 1,000 fin whales, according to Humane World for Animals, which says that most of the whale meat produced is consumed not by Icelanders but by visiting tourists.

Whaling in the early 20th century decimated populations of cetaceans around the world, leading countries to agree to an international ban on whale hunting in 1986. Despite the ban, Norway resumed commercial whaling in 1993, Iceland in 2006, and Japan in 2019.
body.zh: 冰岛是仅有的三个仍然允许在其水域进行商业捕鲸的国家之一，但这种情况可能即将改变。冰岛政府将于二月份提出一项法案，可能禁止这种做法。 冰岛政府今年将允许其最后一家捕鲸公司 Hvalur 捕杀多达 134 头小须鲸和 150 头长须鲸。虽然小须鲸不是受威胁物种，但长须鲸被国际自然保护联盟列为易危物种。今年到目前为止，冰岛已有 80 头成年长须鲸被杀，当局发现被鱼叉刺伤的动物常常承受巨大的痛苦。冰岛食品和兽医局 2023 年发布的一份报告确定，一些鱼叉鲸可能需要两个小时才能死亡。政府表示，目前正在寻求更新捕鲸法，并将考虑永久禁止捕鲸。人道动物世界发言人温迪·希金斯 (Wendy Higgins) 表示：“这确实是一个重要的里程碑，旨在让冰岛残忍和不必要的鲸鱼捕猎成为历史。” 根据动物人道世界的数据，在过去的二十年里，冰岛捕鲸者已经捕杀了 1000 多头长须鲸，该组织表示，生产的大部分鲸肉不是由冰岛人食用，而是由来访的游客食用。 20 世纪初的捕鲸活动导致世界各地的鲸目动物数量锐减，导致各国于 1986 年同意国际禁止捕鲸。尽管有这项禁令，挪威还是于 1993 年恢复了商业捕鲸，冰岛于 2006 年恢复了商业捕鲸，日本于 2019 年恢复了商业捕鲸。

reflection.en: As Iceland contemplates banning commercial whaling, the plight of the vulnerable fin whale comes into focus. This situation calls to mind the ancient wisdom to "Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for all their rights." The potential ban reflects a growing awareness and a moral imperative to protect species facing extinction....
reflection.zh: 当冰岛考虑禁止商业捕鲸时，易危的长须鲸的困境成为焦点。这一情况让人想起古老的智慧：“为不能说话者说话，为所有被遗弃者伸张正义。” 潜在的禁令反映了日益增长的认识和保护濒危物种的道德责任。 As Iceland contemplates banning commercial whaling, the plight of the vulnerable fin...

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Country diary: Notice anything wrong with this ripe, succulent plum? | Claire Stares
title.zh: 乡村日记：这颗饱满多汁的李子有什么不对劲？

This summer has been challenging for the fruit trees in my garden, with intense heat and a lack of rain causing poor cropping, premature ripening and pre-harvest drop. While my dessert and cooking apples have...
summary.zh: 兰斯通，汉普郡：我的花园里长满了维多利亚李子，但它们本不该是脆的。今年夏天对花园里的果树来说充满挑战，酷热和缺雨导致收成不佳、过早成熟和采摘前落果。虽然我的食用和烹饪苹果只结了寥寥几颗矮小、像海棠果一样大的果实，榅桲也光秃秃的，但温室旁那棵维多利亚李子树却是个例外。它的枝头挂满了果实，甚至有几根枝条因不堪重负而折断。

While my dessert and cooking apples have produced just a handful of stunted, crab-apple-sized fruit, and my quince is bare, the Victoria plum growing next to the greenhouse is the exception. Its branches are so heavily laden that several have snapped under the weight. Continue reading...
body.zh: 汉普郡兰斯通：我的花园里长满了维多利亚李子，但它们的内部不应该是脆的。今年夏天对我花园里的果树来说是一个挑战，高温和缺乏雨水导致作物歉收、过早成熟和收获前落果。虽然我的甜点和烹饪苹果只结出了一些发育不良、海棠大小的水果，而且我的榅桲也光秃秃的，但生长在温室旁边的维多利亚李是个例外。它的树枝太重了，有几根在重压下折断了。继续阅读...

This mirrors the hardship described in Habakkuk, where even the fig trees and olive trees may fail, and the fields yield no food. Yet, even amidst such scarcity, the passage calls for finding joy in...
reflection.zh: 今年夏天酷热和干旱严重影响了作者花园里的果树，导致生长受阻和过早成熟。这与哈巴谷书中所描述的困境相似，在那里，无花果树和橄榄树可能都会枯干，田地也毫无收成。然而，即使在这种匮乏之中，这段经文仍呼吁在救恩的雅伟上帝里喜乐。

verse.textZh: 虽然无花果树不发旺，葡萄树不结果……然而，我要因雅伟欢欣。

In Australia, the booming rabbit population, while posing an ecological challenge, is a vivid reminder of the dynamic and sometimes overwhelming abundance of creation. It calls us to consider our role in stewarding this diverse world, recognizing the delicate balance Yahweh has...

verse.textEn: How many are your works, Yahweh! In wisdom you made them all; the earth is full of your creatures.
verse.textZh: 雅伟啊，你所造的何其多！都是你用智慧造成的；遍地满了你的丰富。

title.en: Artist delights in beautiful ‘mess’ and dead trees of England’s rewilding sites
title.zh: 艺术家乐于英格兰重新野化地点的美丽“混乱”和枯木

summary.en: Artist Rebecca Howard spent two years visiting rewilding projects and painting landscapes for a West Sussex exhibition. While detractors may lament the untidiness, deadwood, and perceived 'mess' of these areas, the exhibition highlights the aesthetic beauty found in fungi growing on dying trees, water buffalo in...
summary.zh: 艺术家丽贝卡·霍华德花了两年时间参观重新野化项目，并为西萨塞克斯郡的一个展览绘制风景画。尽管批评者可能对这些地区的不整洁、枯木和所谓的“混乱”感到惋惜，但该展览突出了在枯树上生长的真菌、湿地里的水牛以及河狸池塘淹没的田野中所发现的美学之美。

But a new exhibition highlights the aesthetic delights that can be discovered on rewilding sites where fungi grows on dying trees, water buffalo gather in new wetlands and brown-watered beaver pools flood once-desiccated fields. Continue reading...
